tldr: AI 需求帶動台灣工業與製造業生產指數連 26 紅，4 月零售與餐飲營業額也雙創同期新高。
賴清德總統宣示將深化台歐晶片、AI 與無人機合作，定位台灣為民主供應鏈關鍵節點。
黃仁勳於 COMPUTEX 前夕再度與台積電高層聚餐，凸顯台灣在全球 AI 供應鏈的中樞地位。
Piper Sandler 警告即便美伊達協議，荷莫茲海峽恐再封閉數月，油價衝上新高，加深煉油業營運不確定性。
潤泰集團總裁尹衍樑辭世，享壽 76 歲，落幕橫跨紡織、營建、零售、金融、生技與公益的台灣企業傳奇。

items.title_zh: 台積電分紅溝通會今日登場 董座魏哲家親上第一線
items.title_en: TSMC chairman to host annual bonus communication meeting in person
items.summary_zh: 台積電今（27）日舉行年度分紅溝通會，董事長魏哲家親自向員工說明 2026 年分紅方案。在 AI 半導體景氣火熱、員工酬勞議題敏感之際，市場關注魏董對下半年產能利用率、先進製程議價力，以及亞利桑那、熊本、德勒斯登廠人力布局的釋疑。
items.summary_en: TSMC chairman C.C. Wei will personally chair the company's employee bonus communication meeting today, addressing staff on the 2026 profit-sharing scheme amid heightened sensitivity over compensation in the AI-fuelled semiconductor cycle. Investors will watch for any commentary on H2 capacity utilisation, advanced node pricing power and the long-term staffing plan for Arizona, Kumamoto and Dresden fabs.

items.title_zh: 環球晶董座徐秀蘭：今年市況相對好非常多 預告下半年漲價
items.title_en: GlobalWafers signals H2 price hikes as semiconductor wafer market improves sharply
items.summary_zh: 環球晶董事長徐秀蘭指出，今年矽晶圓市況相較去年「好非常多」，並預告下半年將選擇性調漲價格，主因 12 吋產能仍緊俏、AI 伺服器需求強勁。整個上游矽晶圓供應鏈如合晶、嘉晶、台勝科等同步受惠。
items.summary_en: GlobalWafers chair Doris Hsu told investors that the silicon wafer market is "materially better" than last year and pre-announced selective price hikes in the second half, citing tight 12-inch capacity and AI-server-driven demand. The guidance lifts the entire upstream silicon supply chain, including SAS, Wafer Works and Episil-Precision.

items.title_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳飯局 台積電高層到齊
items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dines with TSMC top brass on eve of COMPUTEX
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳於台北私廚再度宴請台積電高層，董事長魏哲家與主要廠區主管出席。兩人在現場親自發送炒麵飲料給粉絲，象徵客戶與晶圓代工關係緊密，為 COMPUTEX 與新世代 AI 加速器藍圖鋪陳。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang once again gathered TSMC's senior leadership at a private Taipei dining venue, with chairman C.C. Wei and key fab managers reportedly in attendance. The high-profile meal — Huang and Wei personally served fried noodles to fans outside — signals tight customer–foundry alignment heading into COMPUTEX and the next-gen AI accelerator roadmap.

items.title_zh: 夏普、鴻海深度整合 兩路並進 成為鴻海集團戰略藍圖一環
items.title_en: Sharp deepens integration with Hon Hai, embedding "3+3+3" strategy into its own roadmap
items.summary_zh: 夏普新任社長河村哲治來台表示，將與鴻海深度整合，鴻海 3+3+3 戰略架構也納入夏普藍圖。夏普將以 AI 伺服器、電動車、機器人三大新事業並進，同時延伸家電與資訊科技本業，成為鴻海集團 AI 硬體布局的重要支柱。
items.summary_en: Sharp's new president Tetsuji Kawamura said in Taipei that the Japanese consumer electronics maker will deepen integration with parent Hon Hai (Foxconn), folding the group's "3+3+3" strategic framework into Sharp's own roadmap. Sharp will pursue three new businesses — AI servers, EVs and robots — alongside its legacy home appliance and IT product lines, positioning it as a key pillar of Hon Hai's AI hardware push.

items.title_zh: COMPUTEX 大戲 6 月 2 日登場 30 大咖開講 展現對台灣供應鏈的高度關注
items.title_en: COMPUTEX 2026 to convene 30+ keynote speakers from US$10T worth of global tech firms
items.summary_zh: 外貿協會董事長黃志芳表示，台北國際電腦展 6 月 2 日登場，邀請逾 30 位重量級講者，其代表企業總市值高達 10 兆美元，反映全球科技業對 AI 浪潮與台灣供應鏈的高度重視。市場可望取得 AI 伺服器、先進封裝、機器人、矽光子等明確指引。
items.summary_en: TAITRA chairman James C.F. Huang said COMPUTEX, opening June 2 in Taipei, will host more than 30 keynote speakers from companies with combined market cap of US$10 trillion. The line-up reflects intensifying global focus on the AI wave and Taiwan's supply chain. Expect concrete signals on AI-server roadmaps, advanced packaging, robotics and silicon photonics throughout the week.

items.title_zh: 穎崴訂單能見度看到半年 仁武新廠周五動土 今年營收再戰新高
items.title_en: WIN Semi sees 5–6 months of order visibility, breaks ground on Renwu Fab Friday
items.summary_zh: 半導體測試介面大廠穎崴董事長王嘉煌指出，AI 帶動半導體需求超乎預期，訂單能見度已看到五、六個月以後，目前優先極大化產能；29 日仁武新廠動土，全年營收挑戰再寫新高。
items.summary_en: Semiconductor test interface leader WIN Semi (Winway) chairman Wang Chia-Huang said AI-driven semiconductor demand has exceeded expectations and order visibility now stretches five to six months out. The company is fast-tracking capacity expansion, including breaking ground on the new Renwu fab on May 29, and targets a fresh annual revenue record.

items.title_zh: 世芯 3 奈米製程晶片案本月已量產 估 6 月起迎業績爆發
items.title_en: Alchip's 3nm tape-out enters mass production this month, June revenue ramp ahead
items.summary_zh: 世芯首件 3 奈米製程晶片案本月正式量產，預估 6 月起營收將大幅躍升，反映其在超大型雲端業者 ASIC 委託設計鏈中的關鍵地位；先進製程 AI 訓練晶片均價高，將顯著拉抬獲利。
items.summary_en: Alchip Technologies' first 3nm tape-out project has entered mass production this month and is expected to drive a major revenue ramp from June onwards, the company indicated. The milestone underscores Alchip's position in the ASIC-for-hyperscaler value chain, where AI training silicon at advanced nodes commands premium ASPs.

items.title_zh: 鋼鐵業者瞄準 AI 基建商機；鋼市四多加持 中鋼、中鴻、燁興展望向上
items.title_en: Steelmakers eye AI infrastructure as the next demand driver
items.summary_zh: 中鋼、中鴻、燁興等鋼廠調整產品組合切入 AI 基建——資料中心鋼構、電源設備外殼及高規不鏽鋼。全球鋼市景氣轉熱，分析師點出資本支出循環、補庫存、中國傾銷降溫、AI 需求等「四多」加持，下半年展望走升。
items.summary_en: Taiwan steelmakers including China Steel, Chung Hung Steel and Yieh Hsing are pivoting product mixes toward AI infrastructure — data center steel framing, power equipment housings and high-spec stainless. Global steel sentiment has turned warmer on the AI build-out, with analysts citing "four positive forces" (capex cycle, restocking, lower China dumping, AI demand) lifting H2 outlook.

items.title_zh: 台塑化「抗戰」祭三大策略 董座曹明：今年營運會比去年好
items.title_en: Formosa Petrochemical rolls out three-pronged playbook against US–Iran shockwaves
items.summary_zh: 台塑化董事長曹明表示，面對美伊戰爭引發油價波動與料源受阻，公司透過多元採購、調整中東運輸路線、調整製程增產高利產品三招因應，預期今年營運將優於去年；但坦言油價走勢「只有阿拉知道」。
items.summary_en: FPCC chairman Tsao Ming said the refiner is countering oil-supply disruption from the US–Iran conflict via diversified procurement, re-routing Middle East shipping lanes and tweaking the production slate toward higher-margin products. Tsao expects 2026 operations to beat 2025 despite volatile crude, though he cautioned that only "Allah knows" where oil prices ultimately settle.

items.title_zh: AI 趨勢反轉？4 月製造業生產指數年增 15% 經部：不如預期 指向這 2 因素
items.title_en: April manufacturing index +15% YoY but trails forecast, Ministry flags two headwinds
items.summary_zh: 4 月製造業生產指數年增 15.13%，雖仍強勁但低於官方預估。經濟部解釋係去年同期基期偏高及客戶提前拉貨告一段落兩因素所致，使市場對 AI 超級循環樂觀情緒略為降溫，5、6 月數據將是後續關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's April manufacturing production index posted 15.13% YoY growth — strong but below the official forecast. The Ministry of Economic Affairs pointed to two drag factors: a high comparison base and front-loaded shipments having tapered. The print tempers some of the AI-supercycle euphoria and merits close watch for May/June read-through.

items.title_zh: 尹衍樑辭世！親自走工地、凡事要求極致 打造潤泰王國傳奇
items.title_en: Ruentex Group founder Samuel Yin passes away at 76, leaving a financial conglomerate legacy
items.summary_zh: 潤泰集團總裁尹衍樑辭世享壽 76 歲。從家族紡織廠出發，打造橫跨紡織、營建、零售（全聯）、金融（南山人壽）、生技與公益的潤泰王國，是台灣企業界傳奇。後續潤泰金融、保險、地產等版圖接班布局，將是金融業關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Samuel Yin Yan-Liang, founder of Ruentex Group and a towering figure in Taiwanese business, passed away at 76. From a family textile mill he built an empire spanning textiles, construction, retail (Pxmart), finance (Ruentex Financial Holdings stake in Nan Shan Life), biotech and philanthropy. The succession picture across Ruentex's banking, insurance and real-estate units becomes the immediate question for the financial industry.

items.title_zh: 金融競爭力論壇 7 月 1 日登場／富蘭克林：私募市場 助財富傳承
items.title_en: Financial Competitiveness Forum to convene July 1, with private markets and wealth succession as headline themes
items.summary_zh: 經濟日報年度金融競爭力論壇將於 7 月 1 日舉行，富蘭克林等資產管理業者將以「私募市場如何成為財富傳承工具」為主題開講。議程顯示金融業正全面轉向高資產解決方案、另類投資與跨世代規劃。
items.summary_en: Economic Daily News' annual Financial Competitiveness Forum will be held on July 1, with Franklin Templeton among the keynote speakers focused on how private markets can serve as a vehicle for wealth succession. The agenda underlines the industry pivot toward HNW client solutions, alternatives and intergenerational planning.

items.title_zh: 富蘭克林：私募市場 助財富傳承
items.title_en: Franklin Templeton makes the case for private markets as a wealth-succession tool
items.summary_zh: 富蘭克林於 7 月 1 日金融競爭力論壇前夕指出，私募市場（私募股權、私募債權、基礎建設）正成為高資產客戶傳承規劃中愈來愈關鍵的建構模組。此一視角呼應銀行財管 2.0 走向，另類投資、家族信託架構、稅務優化規劃，將是 AUM 成長與手續費收入的主軸。
items.summary_en: Speaking ahead of the July 1 Financial Competitiveness Forum, Franklin Templeton highlights private markets — private equity, private credit and infrastructure — as increasingly important building blocks for HNW wealth transfer plans. The angle dovetails with banks' wealth-management 2.0 push, where alternatives, family-trust wrappers and tax-aware structuring underpin AUM growth and fee margins.

items.title_zh: 環球晶下半年漲價預告 重塑高資產客戶半導體配置論述
items.title_en: GlobalWafers H2 price-hike guidance reshapes HNW portfolio narrative on Taiwan semis
items.summary_zh: 環球晶預告下半年選擇性漲價，並維持產能緊俏訴求，影響不止於股市。結構商品台、投資諮詢委任及自主配置帳戶中與半導體相關（台積電、日月光、環球晶、ASIC 設計）部位，將有更清晰的基本面錨點，財管端可望重新校準結構債票息與下檔保護價位。
items.summary_en: GlobalWafers' pre-announced H2 selective price hikes and bullish capacity narrative resonate beyond pure equities: structured-product desks, advisory mandates and discretionary portfolios with semiconductor tilts (TSMC, ASE, GlobalWafers and ASIC plays) now have a clearer fundamental peg for product reissues and yield enhancement structures. Wealth advisors will likely re-anchor structured-note coupon levels and barrier prices against this refreshed thesis.

items.title_zh: 賴總統：台扮演晶片、AI 供應鏈關鍵 將與歐深化無人機合作
items.title_en: President Lai positions Taiwan as a "key node" in the chip and AI supply chain at Europe Day banquet
items.summary_zh: 賴清德總統 5 月 26 日於「2026 歐洲日晚宴」表示，半導體與 AI 是全球繁榮與民主安全的雙支柱，台灣在高階晶片與 AI 供應鏈扮演關鍵角色，並將深化與歐洲的無人機合作，顯示產業政策與國防工業同步向歐盟靠攏。
items.summary_en: Speaking at the 2026 Europe Day banquet on May 26, President Lai Ching-te said semiconductors and AI are the twin pillars of global prosperity and democratic security, and Taiwan occupies a key role in advanced chip and AI supply chains. Taiwan will also deepen drone collaboration with European partners, signalling parallel industrial-policy and defence-industrial alignment with the EU.

items.title_zh: 少子化大禮包 賴清德總統今拍板 將說明 0-18 歲成長津貼等細節
items.title_en: Cabinet to roll out "Demographic Strategy" package: 0–18 NT$5,000 monthly subsidy, 12-week maternity leave, 14-day paternity leave
items.summary_zh: 賴清德總統今（27）日召開國安會議，拍板「台灣人口對策新戰略-家庭支持篇」：0-18 歲每月 5,000 元成長津貼、彈性育兒假放寬至 6 歲、產假由 8 周延長至 12 周、陪產假由 7 日延長至 14 日，延長期間薪資成本由政府補貼。
items.summary_en: President Lai will today convene a National Security Council meeting to finalise the "Taiwan Population Strategy — Family Support Chapter," including a NT$5,000 monthly growth subsidy for children aged 0–18, expansion of flexible parental leave to age 6, extension of maternity leave from 8 to 12 weeks and paternity leave from 7 to 14 days. Salary costs during extended leave will be subsidised by the government.

items.title_zh: AI 需求旺 工業、製造業生產連 26 紅 上月指數雙創同期新高
items.title_en: Taiwan's industrial and manufacturing production indices both hit fresh April records — 26 consecutive months of YoY growth
items.summary_zh: 經濟部公布 4 月工業生產指數 125.63、製造業生產指數 127.81，年增 14.16% 與 15.13%，雙創歷年同月新高，皆為連 26 紅。AI 伺服器、先進製程晶圓代工與零組件領漲，傳產相對落後。
items.summary_en: The MOEA released April readings of 125.63 (industrial) and 127.81 (manufacturing), up 14.16% and 15.13% YoY respectively — fresh same-month highs and 26 straight months of YoY growth. AI server, advanced-node foundry and component categories led the gains, while traditional sectors lagged.

items.title_zh: 內需續熱！4 月零售業、餐飲業營業額皆創同月新高
items.title_en: Retail and dining sales both set all-time April highs as long weekend and Mother's Day boost demand
items.summary_zh: 連假與母親節加持，4 月零售與餐飲營業額雙創同期新高，內需動能與 AI 出口循環同步，撐起第 2 季消費類股獲利韌性的多頭論述。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's April retail and food-service sales both hit record highs for the month, supported by a long weekend and Mother's Day. The data reinforces a domestic-demand-led growth story alongside the AI export cycle, and supports the case for sticky consumer-discretionary earnings into Q2.

items.title_zh: 台積電投資最在乎什麼？經長透露：不是電價成本 但最在意「這一項」
items.title_en: MOEA minister: TSMC's biggest investment concern isn't power costs but reliable supply
items.summary_zh: 經濟部長受訪表示，台積電在新投資決策上，最關注的並非電價本身，而是供電的穩定與可靠性。此一表態凸顯電網韌性與可調度容量為台灣產業政策核心議題。
items.summary_en: In a closed-door interview, Taiwan's Economic Affairs Minister revealed that what TSMC cares most about when making new investments isn't the electricity cost itself, but the stability and reliability of supply. The signal underscores why grid resilience and dispatchable capacity sit at the centre of Taiwan's industrial-policy debate.

items.title_zh: 美伊達協議？Piper Sandler 潑冷水：荷莫茲海峽恐再封數月 油價飆新高
items.title_en: Piper Sandler dismisses US–Iran deal optimism: Strait of Hormuz could stay disrupted for months, oil hits new highs
items.summary_zh: Piper Sandler 警告，即便美伊達成協議，荷莫茲海峽恐仍將封閉數月，原油布蘭特與西德州價格再創波段新高，後續將牽動運輸燃料、石化利差與主要經濟體 CPI 數據。
items.summary_en: Piper Sandler poured cold water on speculation that a US–Iran deal would quickly normalise crude flows, warning the Strait of Hormuz could remain partially blocked for several more months. Brent and WTI extended gains to fresh cycle highs, with implications for transport fuels, petrochemical margins and headline CPI prints across major economies.

items.title_zh: 台塑化董事長曹明看油價…只有阿拉知道
items.title_en: Formosa Petrochemical chair on oil: "only Allah knows"
items.summary_zh: 在美伊緊張情勢下被問及油價走勢，台塑化董事長曹明直言「只有阿拉知道」。此一發言搭配多元採購、改線運輸、調整製程的三招應對，反映亞洲煉油業在極端地緣不確定性下的營運心態。
items.summary_en: Asked for an oil-price forecast amid the US–Iran tensions, Formosa Petrochemical chairman Tsao Ming candidly said "only Allah knows." The remark, delivered with three-pronged contingency planning (diversified sourcing, alternative shipping routes, product-mix tilt), captures the operating mindset of energy-intensive Asian refiners under extreme geopolitical uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 5 月 27 日重要財經行事曆
items.title_en: May 27 key financial calendar: Asia data, US sentiment and Fed speak headline the day
items.summary_zh: 經濟日報整理今日財經重要行事曆，涵蓋亞洲總經數據、美國消費者信心、央行官員講話及台股重大公告，可作為交易室與私銀晨會的事件路徑層。
items.summary_en: Economic Daily News' May 27 calendar highlights the day's notable macro events and earnings releases for Taiwanese investors — covering Asia macro releases, US consumer sentiment, central-bank speeches and Taiwan corporate announcements. Use this as a routing layer for trading-desk and PB-advisory morning briefs.
